restore_source:
"""候选明确不保留后，按本轮真实原字节备份恢复十份来源；不构建或运行LP。"""

import argparse
import datetime
import hashlib
import json
from pathlib import Path, PurePosixPath
import zipfile


ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
DATA = ROOT / "knowledge/experiments/data/2026-10-12-halpern-ipm"
PLAN_SHA = "43a4851be22770b5c07302b9cfe815b0ac8fb54cec53012d29bc1ff6b66d499e"
BASELINE_SHA = "bec3ba78313f6be093125ed09a8c60e15ca0b1ab1623352cd5b52e287d5bd8a3"
BACKUP_IDENTITY_SHA = "2a87cd0a314818cff43996276adcf1c84dddb900967b2630a37acf7db9af0a52"
BACKUP_ZIP_SHA = "96166a1bf9aaba5813272cceb5b6f4ebbcab80ef22b25e3c76a2ff546d42c7f5"
OUTPUT = DATA / "v64-restored-source.json"


def require(condition, message):
    if not condition:
        raise ValueError(message)


def digest(content):
    return hashlib.sha256(content).hexdigest()


def sha(path):
    return digest(Path(path).read_bytes())


def unique_object(items):
    result = {}
    for key, value in items:
        require(key not in result, "JSON重复字段：" + key)
        result[key] = value
    return result


def read_locked(path, expected):
    content = Path(path).read_bytes()
    require(digest(content) == expected, "输入身份不匹配：" + str(path))
    return json.loads(content.decode("utf-8"), object_pairs_hook=unique_object,
        parse_constant=lambda value: (_ for _ in ()).throw(ValueError("非有限JSON：" + value)))


def local_source(name):
    require(isinstance(name, str), "来源路径不是字符串")
    relative = PurePosixPath(name)
    require(not relative.is_absolute() and relative.as_posix() == name and "\\" not in name and ":" not in name and
        all(part not in ("", ".", "..") for part in relative.parts), "来源路径不规范：" + name)
    path = (ROOT / name).resolve()
    require(path.is_relative_to(ROOT) and path.is_file(), "来源路径越界或不存在：" + name)
    return path


def check_files(expected):
    actual = {name: sha(local_source(name)) for name in expected}
    require(actual == expected, "当前来源或库已经偏离冻结身份，禁止覆盖用户工作")
    return actual


def main(arguments):
    require(not OUTPUT.exists(), "禁止覆盖本轮既有恢复记录")
    plan = read_locked(DATA / "v64-plan.json", PLAN_SHA)
    baseline = read_locked(DATA / "v64-baseline-check.json", BASELINE_SHA)
    backup = read_locked(DATA / "v64-starting-source.json", BACKUP_IDENTITY_SHA)
    candidate = read_locked(DATA / "ipm-v64-identity.json", arguments.identity_sha256)
    require(candidate["plan_sha256"] == PLAN_SHA and backup["plan_sha256"] == PLAN_SHA and
        backup["baseline_check_sha256"] == BASELINE_SHA, "计划与候选或备份来源不一致")
    require(baseline["passed"] is True and backup["readback_verified"] is True and
        baseline["files"] == backup["files"] and baseline["libraries"] == backup["libraries"] and
        baseline["solver_sha256"] == backup["solver_sha256"], "原字节备份与真实起始状态不同")
    require(len(candidate["files"]) == len(backup["files"]) == 95 and
        set(candidate["files"]) == set(backup["files"]) and len(candidate["libraries"]) == 17,
        "来源或库集合不完整")

    decision_name = "v64-gate.json" if arguments.decision == "initial" else "v64-full-gate.json"
    decision = read_locked(DATA / decision_name, arguments.decision_sha256)
    require(decision["plan_sha256"] == PLAN_SHA, "撤回决定不是本轮计划")
    if arguments.decision == "initial":
        require(decision.get("eligible_for_netlib") is False, "初始门槛没有明确拒绝候选")
    else:
        require(decision.get("candidate_identity_sha256") == arguments.identity_sha256 and
            decision.get("retain_candidate") is False and isinstance(decision.get("reason"), str) and
            bool(decision["reason"]), "完整评估没有针对该候选明确作出不保留决定")

    changed = plan["changed_source_files"]
    require(isinstance(changed, list) and len(changed) == len(set(changed)) == 10,
        "恢复范围不是计划十份唯一来源")
    require(sorted(candidate["changed_source_files"]) == sorted(changed) and
        sorted(name for name in backup["files"] if backup["files"][name] != candidate["files"][name]) == sorted(changed),
        "候选相对起始状态的实际差异超出计划")
    targets = {name: local_source(name) for name in changed}
    archive_path = DATA / "v64-starting-source.zip"
    require(backup["source_zip_file"] == archive_path.name and
        sha(archive_path) == BACKUP_ZIP_SHA == backup["source_zip_sha256"], "起始原字节包身份不符")
    with zipfile.ZipFile(archive_path) as archive:
        names = archive.namelist()
        require(len(names) == len(set(names)) == 95 and set(names) == set(backup["files"]), "起始原字节包成员不符")
        contents = {name: archive.read(name) for name in names}
    require({name: digest(value) for name, value in contents.items()} == backup["files"], "起始原字节包内容不符")
    require(contents["tests/test_cli.py"].count(b"cls.benchmark.platform.platform()") == 1,
        "恢复目标未保留独立平台预热")

    candidate_archive = DATA / "ipm-v64-source.zip"
    require(sha(candidate_archive) == candidate["source_zip_sha256"], "冻结候选来源包身份变化")
    with zipfile.ZipFile(candidate_archive) as archive:
        names = archive.namelist()
        require(len(names) == len(set(names)) == 95 and set(names) == set(candidate["files"]), "冻结候选成员不符")
        require({name: digest(archive.read(name)) for name in names} == candidate["files"], "冻结候选来源不符")
    check_files(candidate["files"])
    check_files(candidate["libraries"])
    frozen_candidate = ROOT / ".tools/solver-ipm-v64.exe"
    current_executable = ROOT / "build/release/solver.exe"
    require(sha(frozen_candidate) == sha(current_executable) == candidate["solver_sha256"],
        "当前或冻结候选程序身份变化")

    # 所有决定、来源、路径、库与程序检查通过后，仅写回计划十来源的原字节。
    for name, path in targets.items():
        path.write_bytes(contents[name])
    actual = check_files(backup["files"])
    libraries = check_files(candidate["libraries"])
    require(sha(frozen_candidate) == sha(current_executable) == candidate["solver_sha256"],
        "恢复来源意外改变候选程序")
    result = {"passed": True, "created_at_utc": datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat(),
        "plan_sha256": PLAN_SHA, "baseline_check_sha256": BASELINE_SHA,
        "candidate_identity_sha256": arguments.identity_sha256,
        "decision_file": decision_name, "decision_sha256": arguments.decision_sha256,
        "backup_identity_sha256": BACKUP_IDENTITY_SHA, "backup_source_zip_sha256": BACKUP_ZIP_SHA,
        "restored_files": changed, "source_files": len(actual), "files": actual,
        "platform_test_fix_preserved": True, "all_prechecks_completed_before_source_writes": True,
        "libraries_before_rebuild": libraries, "solver_binary_before_rebuild": candidate["solver_sha256"],
        "restored_numerical_source_version": "ipm-cpu-0.47.0",
        "binary_rebuild_required": True, "lp_runs": 0, "build_runs": 0,
        "restore_source_sha256": sha(__file__), "restore_source": Path(__file__).read_text(encoding="utf-8")}
    with OUTPUT.open("x", encoding="utf-8", newline="\n") as target:
        json.dump(result, target, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2, allow_nan=False)
        target.write("\n")
    print(json.dumps({"passed": True, "restored_files": len(changed), "source_files": len(actual),
        "binary_rebuild_required": True, "lp_runs": 0, "build_runs": 0}, ensure_ascii=False))


if __name__ == "__main__":
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    parser.add_argument("--decision", choices=("initial", "full"), required=True)
    parser.add_argument("--identity-sha256", required=True)
    parser.add_argument("--decision-sha256", required=True)
    main(parser.parse_args())
